CS.SettingsHint: Choose the compendium available from each document sidebar.
CS.SettingsIntro: Select one visible compendium for each sidebar. Leaving a row disabled adds no switch to that sidebar.
CS.LoadFailed: The compendium could not be loaded.
CS.PackUnavailable: That compendium is no longer available. Returning to the World view.
CS.ReadOnlyPack: That pack is read-only. Its folders and source documents cannot be changed.
CS.WorkingCopyCreated: Opened an editable working copy. The read-only source pack is unchanged.
